item.title: The Big Lebrewski Winter Beer Taste – Saturday, November 10, 7pm
item.description: Join your neighbors for a night of brews and tunes from the Phinney Ridge Neighborhood Association! More details and tickets available here: https://www.phinneycenter.org/calendar/winter-beer-taste18/ KBFG will be on the scene spinning some tunes. Come have a beer with us!

item.title: Town Hall Seattle is on KBFG!
item.description: Tune in Monday nights at 6pm to hear archived talks from Town Hall Seattle – a vibrant gathering place in the heart of Seattle, Town Hall fosters an engaged community through civic, arts, and educational programs that reflect—and inspire—our region’s best impulses: creativity, empathy, and the belief that we all deserve a voice.

item.title: Come join us!
item.description: We have a couple fantastic opportunities to get involved with KBFG and help the station continue to evolve and grow: Audio production assistant Social media coordinator Please contact us at info@kbfgseattle.org to learn more!

item.title: New digs!
item.description: KBFG is excited to announce its new home at the Jack Straw Cultural Center located at 4261 Roosevelt Way NE, Seattle, Washington. The move marks a new chapter for the station as it continues to grow and evolve in the community. Photo credit: Lara Swimmer, ORA

item.title: Spring Programmer Meetup – April 15th
item.description: Hi friends, mark your calendars! It’s time once again for getting out of the cloud and getting together to mix, mingle, and meet potential new programmers. We’ll be meeting at the new station space located in the Jack Straw Cultural Center (4261 Roosevelt Way NE in the U District) on Monday, April 15th from 7-9pm. If you’ve been kicking around an idea for a show, this is a great time to learn more about the station and next steps. Rock on!

item.title: New partnership with Daybreak Star Radio
item.description: Daybreak Star Radio is Indigenizing the Airwaves, right here on KBFG! We’re pleased to announce a new KBFG partnership with Daybreak Star Radio, hosted at the Daybreak Star Indian Cultural Center, on Magnolia. Check them out at Daybreak Star Radio (https://www.daybreakstarradio.com). The Daybreak Star Radio Lunch hour airs on KBFG Monday through Friday from Noon to 1pm. Tune in for R&B, Hip Hop, Rock, and new tunes, all from Native American, First Nations, and other Indigenous artists.
